title: Breath
identity: The composer’s current compositions page identifies Breath (2004) for alto saxophone and piano, about 5:30, premiered at Wits University in 2005. A University of Pretoria bibliography indexes a 2005 soprano-and-piano Breath, but this secondary entry’s relationship to the composer-listed alto work is unresolved. The independent South African Saxophone Catalogue reports 5:03; that timing is not treated as a correction.

evidence.claim: Current composer page identifies the 2004 alto saxophone and piano work, about 5:30, and its April 2005 premiere.
Noa Even’s performer-maintained saxophone-and-piano repertoire page lists Breath (2004), alto saxophone and piano, 5:30.

University of Pretoria bibliography indexes a soprano saxophone and piano Breath dated 2005 and lists SAMRO call no. A06414; the page relation to the composer-listed alto work is unresolved. PDF not retrievable.
evidence.source_name: Karlien Gerber, An Annotated Bibliography of Selected Classical Saxophone Works by South African Composers

evidence.claim: SAMRO Scores lists Breath in its work archive; its separate work page failed to open, so score contents/edition were not verified.
Independent South African Saxophone Catalogue lists alto saxophone and piano, 5:03, and premiere details. Duration conflicts with composer/performer records and remains unresolved.

collection_flag: No intended age group was established for the composer-listed 2004 alto work. A University of Pretoria bibliography reports a soprano version, but its relation to this work remains unresolved.

score_links.description: SAMRO Scores work page; the URL did not open during this review, and the score is not inspected.

gaps: Readable score for the 2004 alto version and its exact notation/range remain unavailable.
A verified saxophone recording matching the 2004 alto version remains unlocated.
Duration differs between the composer/performer listing (5:30) and independent catalogue (5:03); edition or timing basis is unresolved.
